fact: 1938年9月29日，德、英、法、意四国首脑在慕尼黑签署协定，原则同意将苏台德德意志人地区割让给德国；协定规定10月1日开始撤离、10月10日完成撤离，不得破坏既有设施，捷克斯洛伐克政府负责执行。

sources.title: Munich Agreement（捷克共和国外交部官方档案 PDF）
sources.quote: Agreement concluded at Munich, September 29, 1938, between Germany, Great Britain, France and Italy……(1) The evacuation will begin on 1st October. (2) The United Kingdom, France and Italy agree that the evacuation of the territory shall be completed by the 10th October, without any existing installations having been destroyed.

fact: 按慕尼黑协定，德军分四阶段于10月1日至7日占领苏台德四个划定区域：I区10月1—2日、II区10月2—3日、III区10月3—5日、IV区10月6—7日，其余主要为德意志人的地区由国际委员会划定后于10月10日前占领。

sources.title: Munich Agreement（捷克共和国外交部官方档案 PDF）
sources.quote: The occupation by stages of the predominantly German territory by German troops will begin on 1st October. The four territories marked on the attached map will be occupied by German troops in the following order: The territory marked No. I on the 1st and 2nd of October; the territory marked No. II on the 2nd and 3rd of October; the territory marked No. III on the 3rd, 4th and 5th of October; the territory marked No. IV on the 6th and 7th of October.

fact: 1938年9月21日波兰正式向捷克斯洛伐克提出切欣（泰申）地区领土要求，9月30日午夜向捷发出最后通牒；10月1日上午捷政府接受波兰要求，10月2日波兰军队在博尔特诺夫斯基将军指挥下吞并该地区，面积801.5平方公里、人口227,399人。

sources.title: Munich Wiki
sources.quote: On 2 October, the Polish Army, commanded by General Bortnowski, annexed an area of 801.5 km2 with a population of 227,399 people.

fact: 1939年3月15—16日，德军进驻捷克斯洛伐克剩余领土，希特勒从布拉格城堡宣布波希米亚和摩拉维亚保护国成立；第二共和国灭亡，这是慕尼黑协定后不到半年的最终结局。

sources.title: Protectorate of Bohemia and Moravia (English Wikipedia)
sources.quote: Following the establishment of the independent Slovak Republic on 14 March 1939, and the German occupation of the Czech rump state the next day, Adolf Hitler established the protectorate on 16 March 1939, issuing a proclamation from Prague Castle.

sources.title: 捷克国家概况 (中国驻捷克使馆经商处)
sources.quote: 1938年9月，英、法、德、意四国代表在慕尼黑签署了《慕尼黑协定》，将捷克斯洛伐克的苏台德地区割让给德国。1939年3月捷被纳粹德国占领。

fact: 慕尼黑协定使捷克斯洛伐克丧失了约70%的钢铁工业、70%的电力供应与全部边境防御工事，以及约350万人口；割让苏台德后，捷克国防工业基础被抽空，斯柯达（Skoda）等兵工产能在1939年3月德国占领剩余领土后落入德国战争经济。

sources.title: Munich Agreement (English Wikipedia)
sources.quote: Czecho-Slovakia (as the state was now renamed) lost its defensible border with Germany and the Czechoslovak border fortifications. Without them its independence became more nominal than real. Czechoslovakia also lost 70 per cent of its iron/steel industry, 70 per cent of its electrical power and 3.5 million citizens to Germany as a result of the settlement.

sources.title: The History of Skoda (Volkswagen Group)
sources.quote: Allocated to the Reich manufacturing corporation headed by Hermann Goering, the production of civilian vehicles took a back seat. Skoda instead became part of the war economy, producing aviation parts, munitions and trucks until 1945.

fact: 斯柯达兵工厂在1939年德国占领后被划入由戈林领导的帝国制造集团（Reichsfabrik），民用车生产退居次要，转而生产航空零件、弹药与卡车直至1945年。

sources.title: The History of Škoda（Volkswagen Group 官方品牌史）
sources.quote: Allocated to the Reich manufacturing corporation headed by Hermann Göring, the production of civilian vehicles took a back seat. Škoda instead became part of the war economy, producing aviation parts, munitions and trucks until 1945.

fact: 慕尼黑协定第7条规定转移地区内居民有权在6个月内选择迁入或迁出；第8条规定捷政府须在4周内从军队与警察中释放在押的苏台德德意志政治犯——协定同时为人口转移与政治清洗留出了法律通道。

sources.title: Munich Agreement（捷克共和国外交部官方档案 PDF）
sources.quote: (7) There will be a right of option into and out of the transferred territories, the option to be exercised within six months from the date of this agreement. (8) The Czechoslovak Government will within a period of four weeks from the date of this agreement release from their military and police forces any Sudeten Germans who may wish to be released.

fact: 苏台德德意志社会民主党领袖文策尔·雅克斯（Wenzel Jaksch）于1938年10月初飞赴伦敦，向英国政府请求为其反纳粹苏台德社会民主党同事约2万人签发避难签证；英国政府为此专门划拨350张特别签证，其中250张分配给苏台德德意志人，但这些签证仅准许临时入境英国，难民还须有在英生活保障。到1939年3月德军进入布拉格时，仍有许多难民未获安置。

sources.title: British Immigration Control Procedures and Jewish Refugees 1933-1942 (CORE thesis, PRO archives)
sources.quote: The leader of the non-Nazi Sudeten Germans, Wenzel Jaksch, mounted effective pressure on behalf of endangered followers of his German Social Democratic party. He arrived in the UK in early October, seeking a haven for up to 20,000 adherents, and his proposals for refuge in the dominions were urgently taken up with dominion governments.……From the sole quota of 350 special British visas for endangered refugees from Czechoslovakia which was made available prior to the end of October 1938, 250 were allocated to Sudeten Germans. These visas authorised admission to the UK on a temporary basis only, and the refugees were also required to have guaranteed maintenance during their stay.

fact: 苏台德割让后，捷克斯洛伐克丧失了约350万人口（主要为德意志族）、70%钢铁工业与全部边境工事；捷克公务员、警察与军队从割让区撤出，反纳粹苏台德德意志难民（社会民主党人等）逃往残余捷克领土，1938年10月下旬在英寻求安置的难民估计从4万人降至1.5万人。割让区内捷克居民的住房、工作与财产地位由6个月选择权条款决定。
